caption:
Cook Sicilian pasta with a chef in Palermo.

From pistachios in a wooden mortar to spaghetti with clams, golden arancini and cannoli with ricotta cream and candied orange: this is a hands-on Sicilian cooking class in Chef Giacomo Napolitano's kitchen in Palermo. Small groups, English spoken, and you eat what you cooked.

Book your class on risthome.it (link in bio)
